recognize_zh: 這是 CD45 對側向散射（SSC）的流式細胞儀圖（非形態圖）：CD45 弱陽性、低 SSC 的母細胞區占 85.22%，顆粒球 6.75%、淋巴球 4.22%，單核球僅 0.07%，顯示母細胞大量增加且幾乎沒有單核球。
features: Flow cytometry plot of live events: CD45-KO (x-axis) versus side scatter (y-axis)
Dominant CD45-dim, low side-scatter blast gate comprising 85.22% of events
Lymphocytes 4.22% in the CD45-bright low side-scatter region
describe_en: Flow cytometric CD45 versus side-scatter analysis of live events shows a dominant CD45-dim, low side-scatter population in the blast gate accounting for 85.22% of events, with residual granulocytes (6.75%) and lymphocytes (4.22%). The monocyte gate contains only 0.07% of events. The marked expansion of the blast region supports acute leukemia, requiring lineage assignment with a full antibody panel. Profound monocytopenia is a characteristic feature of GATA2 deficiency, although in this sample it is also influenced by leukemic replacement.
